data_fields.name: luck_roll_sides
data_fields.donor_constant: d24 (roll 1..24, at or below luck sets the mode)

data_fields.name: damage_min_max
data_fields.donor_constant: troop table minimum and maximum (not read per unit)

best_idea: A single attack-to-defence ratio, clamped at both ends (0.2x to 3.0x in this donor), applied to a per-weapon min-max roll, gives a readable hit formula with a few numeric knobs per weapon.
decision_why: The clamped attack-to-defence ratio and the min-max roll fit a fast duel, but the donor's luck roll is client-side and its caps can reach 3.0x in one hit, so Frankendom must seed the roll on the server and keep the caps as catalogue data; the stack kill model does not fit single-character duels.
acceptance: A server test with attack 15 against defence 10 gives factor 1.5 and a hit inside [min x 1.5, max x 1.5]; attack 40 against defence 0 gives factor 3.0; attack 0 against defence 40 gives factor 0.2 and never less than 1 damage; the same seed gives the same hit on both clients.
